The '''LCS 2019 Summer''' was the second split of the 2019 [[League of Legends Championship Series]] (LCS), organized by Riot Games. It ran from June 1 to August 25, 2019, with the regular season held at the NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles and the Playoffs concluding at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit, United States. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage ({{Abbr/Bo1}}), followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket ({{Abbr/Bo5}}). The winner qualified for the [[World Championship/2019|2019 World Championship]], while the top teams earned Championship Points for Worlds seeding.

The split was played on patch 9.10 with updates through 9.15. The prize pool totaled $200,000 USD, and the format allowed the first and second place teams from the Group Stage to advance directly to the Semifinals of Playoffs, while third to sixth place competed in the Quarterfinals.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 1st - August 4th, 2019''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of Playoffs.
**** 3rd place team faces 6th place team, 4th place team faces 5th place team
**** 1st place team from Group Stage will select their opponent from Quarterfinals
**** 2nd place team from Group Stage will face the remaining team from Quarterfinals
* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 10th - 25th, 2019''
<!--** Quarterfinals played on August 25-26, 2018 in NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles, California.
** Semifinals played on September 01-02, 2018 in NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles.-->
** Finals played on September August 25, 2019 in [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_Caesars_Arena Little Caesars Arena], Detroit, Michigan.
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner Qualifies for [[World Championship/2019|World Championship 2019]]
